{{Quote|When Moff Garreter mobilized his fleet to assist Head of State Fel, Moff Woolbam attempted to annex Rimcee Station. Garreter was forced to divert to protect the integrity of his holdings.|A newscaster, during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]]|<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>}}
[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] '''Woolbam''' was a member of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. In [[44 ABY]], during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]], he sided with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] and the renegade Moff against [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]].<ref name="Ascension" /> Woolbam tried to [[Attack on Rimcee Station|annex]] [[Rimcee Station]] when rival Moff [[Garreter]] sent his forces in aid of Fel. Having learned Woolbam's actions against his territories, Garreter redirected his forces to protect Rimcee Station. In the meantime, Moff Woolbam's forces were also involved in a [[Battle of Muunilinst (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|battle at Muunilinst]].<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
